No current price, 20-day dollar-volume, bid/ask spread, adjusted-price history, consensus surprise, or options-implied move was verified. Prices, scores, probabilities, ranks and return forecasts must remain null.

horizons.return_definition_if_prices_later_suppli: Day: 2026-10-19 regular-session open to that session close. Week: the same October 19 open through the fifth regular-session close on 2026-10-23. Use prices and distributions reconciled to one consistent share basis. The October 16 close is a historical reference only; exclude the untradeable prior-close-to-entry/weekend opening gap. Opening and closing prices are prospective simulation references, not guaranteed fills.
horizons.calendar_note: October 19–23 are Monday–Friday, with no scheduled NYSE market holiday or early close listed. Unscheduled closures or individual halts are not forecast.
horizons.publication_timing_assumption: This window applies to a snapshot published after the October 16 close and before the October 19 regular-session open. If publication is at or after that open, compute a new first-session entry and five-session exit; do not reuse the old entry.
horizons.last_completed_regular_session_role: Historical reference and input-availability date only; never an executable entry or an earned opening-gap return.
horizons.next_week_definition: Rolling five exchange sessions beginning with the first regular-session open after publication, not the next calendar week.
horizons.entry_reference: Prospective regular-session opening price on 2026-10-19, currently unobserved; simulation reference, not a guaranteed fill.
horizons.window_state_rule: After the October 19 entry open, label this snapshot Window in progress; archive it after its selected exit. A new entry requires a new snapshot.
horizons.event_boundary_rule: Pre-entry releases cannot receive an in-window future-catalyst badge. Releases after the chosen exit are outside the holding window. Date-only events that cross a boundary have unknown eligibility.
